name: Blink
notes:
With no dash charge, Blink only teleports and deals its own damage.
Teleports you a dodge distance.
The recast spends 1 dash charge, so Blink and dodging share that resource. Blink itself never needs a dash charge. Elemental Affinity never boosts it; spell crit does.

In game (hwp_sor_blink, tested): a 90 px teleport (85.5 with the wall margin), pure damage within the radius in game units. With a dash charge it replays the last fire, ice or lightning spell (or the Elemental Orb) from the start, cost paid down to 1 mana, its cooldown restarted.
summary: Teleport a short distance, dealing Pure damage to every enemy near where you reappear. If you have a dash charge, Blink spends it to recast your last cast elemental spell from your original location, regardless of cooldown or mana cost. It recasts even while that spell is on cooldown or you can't afford it; the cost is still paid, and if you can't afford it the recast leaves you at 1 mana. The recast also restarts that spell's cooldown from the beginning.
